name: @avatark/world-embodiment-contracts
description: Renderer-neutral spatial/presentation/interaction contracts bridging Living Systems' authoritative WorldSnapshot to concrete renderers: SpatialNode, EnvironmentPresentation, EntityPresentation, EncounterPresentation, WorldEmbodimentSnapshot, InteractionIntent, EmbodimentDelta. No implementations, no React, no Unreal, zero franchise content. Depends only on @avatark/runtime-contracts, @avatark/renderer-contracts, and @avatark/living-systems-contracts -- reuses their existing shapes (TransitionAffordance, EnvironmentalBand, VisitorContextProjection, ProtectedNarrativeProjection) rather than redeclaring them.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --outDir dist --declaration --noEmit false --rewriteRelativeImportExtensions --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler && node ../../scripts/fix-dts-extensions.mjs dist
